title: Research: save 48,400 JP8 primitives with a restored compensation basis (no new kappa)
body:
The selected #626/#622 JP8 supplier's frame-zero compensation contains 8,800 additions. Factoring its rational target rows through 56 disjoint, restored target pairs reduces that to **4,596 additions**, including every preparation and restoration gate. The complete emitted scalar program saves **48,400 real-component primitives per orientation** under the unchanged coefficient lowering.

**Status: research construction / finite complex-supplier circuit improvement; no new κ.**

| Quantity | Original | Replacement |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Full-program scalar macros, either orientation | 22,693 | 18,489 |
| Forward real scalar primitives | 257,232 | 208,832 |
| Backward real scalar primitives | 257,280 | 208,880 |

The proof preserves arbitrary target and helper inputs through `T^-1(Ty + TCh) = y + Ch`. Helpers are read but not written during the replacement. Both target basis changes, coefficient preparation, source reads and clearing are charged. All non-scalar events, frames, 492 helpers, paid children, center operations and ordered wrappers are unchanged. Forward prefix growth is unchanged; the backward bound increases slightly while remaining at 101 bits, below the inherited 192-bit local allowance. No runtime speedup, global invoice or changed recurrence exponent is claimed.

Only `research/complex-compensation-basis/` is added. It contains the written proof, exact recipe/certificate, source pins, bounded search, separate integer arithmetic replay, rejection controls, local claim and validation record.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/complex-compensation-basis/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_COMPLEX_COMPENSATION_BASIS pairs=56 compensation=8800->4596 saved_real_primitives=48400 columns=716 controls=10+25 kappa=unchanged`.

Verification passes on macOS arm64, CPython 3.14.5:

- All 716 input columns of both original and candidate scalar programs in both orientations; a separate Fraction boundary check; unchanged native emitter and frame/wrapper auditor on the changed word.
- Ten new controls, 25 inherited controls and six focused mathematical tests. Omitted preparation passes helper-only testing but fails arbitrary target-input testing.
- Exact reproduction of all 124,320 pair/coefficient scores and one seed-24 greedy disjoint pass; 3,095 profitable candidates. No optimality claim.
- Normal and optimized execution, minimal relocated checkout, alternate gzip packaging, corrupt source/recipe/certificate rejection, and assertion-enabled native subprocesses under an optimized environment.
- `make selected-record-check`, documentation links and staged whitespace pass.

Exact base: **66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60**. Selected #626: `660de893d27bb7abd1d5b01b1640207528a5c851`; #622: `f69477f4f6d3c7eb1f740b166881bffed4ffa9f6`. Full payload hashes also bind the input word/programs to the selected SPEC. OS assignment seed **24**, complex-supplier track. No pinned coordination issue exists; the claim is local. Final overlap inspection reaches #748; upstream main remains the exact base.

Credit to Jeremy Kothe, Chafik Boukhalfa, DreamingOfClouds, icekylinx, Dominik Scholz, Dugongue, eumemic and retained predecessors. Concurrent **#713/#716** are credited for restored target bases in binary R420; this transfers that mechanism to rational JP8 with coefficient-dependent prices and cold-wrapper obligations. **#696/#723/#734** lower individual coefficients; **#722/#739** share cleanup coefficient work; **#681** changes raw factory gates. No pending implementation is imported and no additive saving is asserted.

Prepared by **Sricharan Vagvala (@theon199)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, Apache-2.0. Parent-only execution; no independent human review is claimed.

Production integration still requires a typed alternative-compensation construction step, refreshed bindings and global hosting/invoice/outer admission. All inherited compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape/recovery and analytic assumptions remain. Full repository/cold supplier replay, Linux CI and Lean were not run. This is a finite circuit result, not a formal multiplication theorem. The selected frontier and `upstream/` are untouched.
